description: How the roles of the publishing business relate to each other: newsrooms publish to readers and subscribers, advertisers fund journalism against premium contexts, and consented reader data closes the targeting and measurement loop.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Selling campaigns, sponsorships, and audience reach

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Publishing and delivering journalism across surfaces

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Subscription revenue and advertising spend funding the newsroom

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Engagement signals, first-party data, and campaign measurement

relations.name: Publishes stories to readers
relations.description: Breaks and packages news across homepage, app, push, newsletters, search, and social so habitual readers get the most relevant stories each time they return.

relations.name: Delivers premium journalism
relations.description: Produces the premium stories, editions, and utility features that make a paid product such as Mail+ or inews feel worth renewing month after month.

relations.name: Converts readers into known users
relations.description: Uses registration prompts, newsletters, and app nudges to turn anonymous repeat visits into logged-in relationships that can later become subscriptions.

relations.name: Feeds engagement signals
relations.description: Reading depth, return frequency, and follow-on clicks tell editors which stories and packages are working and what to lead with next.

relations.name: Funds journalism through subscriptions
relations.description: Subscription and bundle payments provide the recurring reader revenue that funds the newsroom independently of the advertising cycle.

relations.name: Targets campaigns at audiences
relations.description: Books campaigns against consented, first-party audience segments in premium editorial contexts, reaching readers at portfolio scale.

relations.name: Funds journalism through ad spend
relations.description: Agency and brand budgets spent on display, video, and native inventory are the advertising revenue line that pays for free-to-read journalism.

relations.name: Commissions sponsored and commerce content
relations.description: Buys sponsored formats, branded content, and commerce packages that commercial and editorial teams produce and clearly label alongside news output.

relations.name: Returns audience data and campaign outcomes
relations.description: Consented reader behavior powers the segments buyers target and the delivery and outcome reporting that proves campaigns performed.
